# Triggercmd

TRIGGERcmd is a cloud service that allows you to securely and remotely run commands on your computers.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/triggercmd/.

## Actions

- **List TriggerCMD Commands** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all commands across your computers.
- **List TriggerCMD Computers** (read-only): List all computers associated with your triggercmd account.
- **Trigger Command**: Trigger a specified command on a target computer.
